column1: # content/source/equipMods.csv — the modifier VOCABULARY for equipment.
# Equipment carries no code. It carries strings like "strike.damage=+4"
# this table is the only place that says what may appear after the dot and
# what it does. An unregistered field is a hard test failure
# ("strike.dmg=3") fails loudly instead of silently doing nothing.
# scope   card  rewrites a card named in equipTargets.csv
#         run   applies to the run itself (the prefix is always `self`)
# apply   amount       set/adjust the amount of the first `op` effect
#                      APPENDING one aimed at `effTarget` if the card has none
#         hits         set/adjust the damage effect's native hit count
#         cost         set/adjust the card's energy cost
#         scale        adjust every numeric amount on the card at once
#         status       set/adjust the stacks of an applyStatus for `status`
#         startStatus  apply `status` to the player at the start of each fight
#         maxHp        added to run max HP (and current HP) at run creation
# clause  appended to the card's rules text when the mod introduces a token
#         the text does not already mention. Blank = nothing to say.
# Value syntax in weapons.csv / outfits.csv:  =N replaces
